primitives.meaning: a recorded entry: account created, trial started, subscription started, or customer onboarding started
entryFilters: a recorded entry: account created, trial started, subscription started, or customer onboarding started
no instance of this journey is already open for the person
hard gates (GLB-31) allow communication for this purpose

primitives.does: Read the onboarding context: the declared goal, the role, the product or use-case, the setup complexity, the account or organisation type, any implementation requirement, and any stated need for assistance. Plan tier is not read as a proxy for any of these

primitives.asks: Does reaching value here require assisted onboarding?

branches.label: Assisted
branches.test: the setup work genuinely needs a person: an implementation, a migration, a configuration the account cannot complete alone, or an explicit request for help

branches.label: Self-service
branches.test: the setup work is within what the account can complete on its own, whatever its value or plan

primitives.does: Record the assisted route and raise the internal task that gives this onboarding a human owner - the route is a property of the onboarding, carried into every step that follows
Record the self-service route, which stays revisable: discovering later that a person is needed is a re-route, not a failure

primitives.asks: Is a critical prerequisite missing before onboarding can start at all?

branches.label: Blocked at the start
branches.test: something named and mandatory is absent - a verification, an access grant, a required party - and nothing meaningful can proceed without it

branches.label: Clear to start
branches.test: no mandatory prerequisite is outstanding; incomplete optional fields do not count

primitives.on: a mandatory prerequisite missing before onboarding can begin
carries: the named requirement, not a general sense that setup is unfinished
the chosen route, since who resolves the requirement depends on it

primitives.on: a route chosen and nothing blocking the start
carries: the chosen route and why it was chosen
the onboarding context, so the first step does not re-ask what was already known
